restrictions.location: Harbour St 48 m East of Lake Shore Blvd W to 48 m East of Lake Shore Blvd W

In completion, the building will be a 59-storey mixed-use building with a total of 984 units. The building is served by a 4-storey underground parking garage that accommodates both residential and commercial parking. Parking, drop-off and loading is internal to the site and accessed from Harbour Street. Additionally, the development includes the dedication of an on-site public park and public realm improvements with more generous sidewalks, landscaping and dedicated cyclists infrastructure. The development is subject to site-specific By-law 1012-2022 and received NOAC on March 11, 2025. Through the Site Plan process, a Construction Management Plan dated February 20, 2024, prepared by Rockwell Tor
